result.summary: Design docs/design/ISS-0132-platform-guard.md of the fix of ISS-0132 for REQ-110 criteria 12-19, in the form of the REQ-110 design. A new pure module tools/src/platform-guard.js: SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS [linux, darwin], isSupportedPlatform (no default, undefined refused), platformRefusal (the shown shape of node-floor.js, else «неизвестная платформа»), refuseUnsupportedPlatform(stderr, platform = process.platform); the Russian refusal line is exact in section 2. Five entries refuse right after their floor guard: team (main, code 2), team-web (run, 2), pixel-office (run, after the help, 1), pixel-office-note (main, after the help, 2), e2e (run.js, 2); hook.js drops the event as the first statement of run() (code 0, quiet, nothing read or sent). Second layer: claude-cli check() gets the first rule E_PLATFORM from io.platform ?? process.platform, with one row each in EXECUTOR_MESSAGES, PREFLIGHT_CODES and WHY_NOT_STARTED (exact texts, section 4). ensureHome(home, fsImpl = fs) and ensureStateDir(dir, fsImpl = fs) read the mode back after chmod and refuse with E_HOME and E_STATE_DIR (exact messages, section 5); the false notice is gone. README: a section ## Platforms after ## Check and the two rights lines (exact texts, section 6). Tests: tools/test/platform-guard.test.js PLT-01..PLT-15 and HK-41, HK-42 in tools/test/pixel-office-hook.test.js (17 tests; the prefix PLT because PG-01..PG-28 exist). 34 mutants (U1-U8, E1-E9, H1-H3, T1-T2, X1-X5, M1-M4, D1-D2, G1), at least one per criterion; the tag itself is the measured mutant «guard absent» of every place. Replacement table: no earlier test changes. CODE-FIXER write set: 13 files (section 12); the new module is BACKEND-DEV's by WF-03 «Roles». All facts measured on a real win32 (this PC) on fresh clones of the tag and of a sketch of the fix under <scratch>; the Linux side goes to GitHub (section 15). Nothing ported.

Process point for Q13: an id taken from a task example is checked against the existing ids before use.

Owner of the new module: WF-03 «Roles» says a new module is written by BACKEND-DEV; the route of the run names only CODE-FIXER 04. The design gives S1 (tools/src/platform-guard.js) to BACKEND-DEV and 13 files to CODE-FIXER; if ORCH gives the module to step 04, it is its fourteenth file.

The other chmod places (ensureModes, the project files, the lock, the channel, the Pixel Office secret and small files, the journal) are not read back: not a criterion; on Windows they are behind the entry refusal, and on Linux and macOS a file system that keeps no modes is refused earlier by the read-back of the same folder. A follow-up LOW only if ORCH wants it (design section 16 item 2).

No Linux on this PC (WSL needs virtualisation that is not installed; the Docker engine is not running), so the win32 preload on Linux, the thin client under win32 against linux and the existing tests are proved on GitHub (design section 15).
